workflows.name: Text to Video
notes: Supply a non-empty `prompt`. Use concrete motion and camera instructions, for example a tracking shot, a slow pan, or a stationary camera. Select the output framing with `aspect_ratio`.
To animate existing images, use `kling-video/v4.0/image-to-video`. To guide a new video with image or video references, use `kling-video/v4.0/reference-to-video`.

Use the exact field names and values listed above. `duration` must be an integer from 3 to 30, and `resolution` must be `720p` or `1080p`. Omit unused media fields instead of sending empty strings or nulls.
The schema permits additional properties, but undocumented keys do not create new model controls. Use only the parameters documented for this endpoint.
A non-empty prompt is required. Use one of the four listed aspect ratios; `adaptive` is not allowed for Text to Video.

workflows.name: Image to Video

help.fr: Images intermédiaires, dans l’ordre : Kling les place lui-même entre le début et la fin (8 au plus).
help.en: In-between frames, in order: Kling places them itself between the start and the end (8 at most).

notes: Frames are sent in this order: `image_url` → each entry in `image_urls` → `end_image_url`, if supplied. Put middle frames in the order you want them used. The schema allows at most 8 middle frames, leaving room for one first frame and one end frame: up to 10 images in total.
Only `image_url` is required. An end frame or middle frames alone cannot start a valid request. Omit unused optional frame fields rather than sending empty URL strings.
This endpoint does not expose an `aspect_ratio` parameter. Prepare your input frames with the desired composition; use `resolution` to select 720p or 1080p output.

Use the exact field names and values listed above. `duration` must be an integer from 3 to 30, and `resolution` must be `720p` or `1080p`. Omit unused media fields instead of sending empty strings or nulls.
The schema permits additional properties, but undocumented keys do not create new model controls. Use only the parameters documented for this endpoint.
The first frame is required even when middle or end frames are supplied. Nine or more middle frames are rejected. `aspect_ratio` is not a documented control for this mode.
